title: A simple AI-enabled method for quantifying bacterial adhesion on dental materials
summary: An AI-enabled SEM image-analysis method quantifies bacterial adhesion over time on specified dental materials, producing measured differences in adhesion/growth.
ai_technology: Experiments use P. gingivalis/F. nucleatum on zirconia and S. mutans on nanostructured PMMA; image-derived cell counts are compared across time/material conditions.

evidence.tested: An AI-enabled SEM image-analysis method quantifies bacterial adhesion over time on specified dental materials, producing measured differences in adhesion/growth.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the tested species, substrates, and in-vitro setup; AI is used for measurement rather than causal interpretation. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Experiments use P. gingivalis/F. nucleatum on zirconia and S. mutans on nanostructured PMMA; image-derived cell counts are compared across time/material conditions.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
